blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Post-training foundation video models on heterogeneous reward-weighted data usually assumes that all data categories induce compatible updates. This assumption is fragile when categories correspond to different skills, domains, or evaluation dimensions. We study this problem in text-to-video post-training, where VBench2.0 dimensions define data buckets and an external multimodal reward pipeline assigns sample weights. We propose G 3 -LoRA ( G radient- G uided G rouped LoRA), a data organization procedure that probes category-level gradients induced by reward-weighted video samples, removes the shared global update direction, clusters categories by residual gradient compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and consolidates them into one adapter by weight merging followed by on-policy distillation from the experts. We motivate this procedure by viewing reward-weighted flow matching as velocity-field regression: incompatible reward dimensions may prefer different denoising directions in overlapping noisy latent regions, causing shared LoRA training to average capabilities. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers, the merged grouped adapter improves the matched VBench2.0 evaluation over the base model, a joint reward-weighted LoRA baseline, and random, semantic, and raw-gradient partitions trained with the same pipeline; an independent evaluator agrees, and on CogVideoX-2B grouping avoids the negative transfer of joint training. The gain is not uniform: merging compresses the largest specialist gains, distillation recovers part of this loss, and camera motion and several local-quality dimensions remain challenging. Together, these results suggest that gradient compatibility can serve as a practical diagnostic for organizing reward-weighted video post-training data.
blocks.zh: 培训后基础关于各种奖励加权数据的视频模型通常假定所有数据类别都会引起兼容的更新。 当类别与不同的技能、领域或评价层面相对应时,这一假设是脆弱的。 我们在文字到视频的后训练中研究这个问题,其中V Bench2.0维度定义了数据桶,外部的多式联运奖励管道分配了样本权重. 我们建议采用G 3-LORA(G radient-G uided G rouped LORA)这一数据组织程序,对奖励加权视频样本引发的类别级梯度进行探测,取消共享的全球更新方向,通过剩余梯度兼容性进行集群分类,培训特定组级的LORA专家,并按重量将其合并为一个适配器,然后由专家进行政策提炼。 我们通过将奖励加权流量匹配视为速度-场回归来推动这一程序:不相容的奖励层面可能倾向于在相互重叠的吵闹潜伏区域采取不同的调试方向,导致共同的LORA训练达到平均能力. 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffuses上,合并的分组适配器改进了匹配的V Bench2.0对基模的评价,联合奖励加权的LORA基线,以及随机的,语义的,和经过同一管道训练的原始的分级;独立评价者同意,在CogVideoX-2B分组上避免了联合训练的负转移. 收益并不统一:合并压缩最大的专家收益,蒸馏回收部分损失,镜头运动和几个局部质量维度仍然具有挑战性. 这些结果表明,梯度兼容性可以作为一种实用的诊断,用于组织奖励加权的视频培训后数据。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Post-training pipelines increasingly rely on heterogeneous supervision. A single adapter may be trained on data from multiple domains, tasks, preference sources, or quality dimensions. The default engineering choice is simple: mix all data and optimize one model. This choice is convenient, but it hides a strong assumption: data categories that share a model should also share compatible optimization directions.
blocks.zh: 培训后管道越来越依赖不同的监督。 单一适配器可接受多个域、任务、偏好来源或质量维度的数据培训。 默认工程选择很简单:混合所有数据并优化一个模型. 这种选择是方便的,但它隐藏了一个强烈的假设:共享一个模型的数据类别也应该共享兼容的优化方向.

blocks.en: This paper asks whether that assumption should be measured rather than accepted. We focus on text-to-video generation because evaluation already decomposes model quality into multiple dimensions. VBench and VBench2.0 evaluate properties such as human identity, camera motion, material change, multi-view consistency, and complex plot faithfulness ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . These dimensions are usually treated as reporting axes after generation, but they can also define post-training data buckets. A model can generate candidate videos for each bucket, an external multimodal model can score them, and the resulting reward-weighted data can be used to train a LoRA adapter ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . The open question is how those buckets should be combined before adapter training.
blocks.zh: 本文询问是否应衡量而不是接受这一假设。 我们侧重于文本到视频生成,因为评价已经将模型质量分解成多个维度. V Bench和V Bench2.0评价人类身份,相机运动,物质变化,多视图一致性,以及复杂情节的忠诚度等属性(Huang等人,2024年;Zheng等人,2025年). 这些维度通常在生成后作为报告轴处理,但也可以定义培训后的数据桶. 一个模型可以生成每个桶的候选视频,一个外部的多式联运模型可以给它们打分,由此产生的奖励加权数据可以用来训练一个LORA适配器(Hu等人,2022年). 问题是,在适配器训练之前,这些桶应该如何组合。

blocks.en: The answer is not obvious. Some dimensions appear semantically related but may prefer different local updates; others appear unrelated but may share geometric, temporal, or object-centric structure. Human identity consistency may reward stable subject appearance, while dynamic attribute tasks emphasize visible change. Camera motion and multi-view consistency may share 3D structure, but they can differ in how much motion the generated video should contain. A single mixed adapter may improve average quality while quietly degrading conflict-heavy dimensions. Conversely, training one adapter per dimension avoids interference but loses data sharing. We therefore treat category organization as a first-class post-training problem.
blocks.zh: 答案并不明显。 某些维度看起来是紧密相连的,但可能倾向于不同的局部更新;另一些则看起来无关紧要,但可能具有几何、时间或以物体为中心的结构。 人类身份一致性可能奖励稳定的主体外观,而动态属性任务则强调可见的变化. 相机运动和多视图一致性可能共享3D结构,但它们在生成的视频应包含多少运动上可能有所不同. 单一混合适配器可以提高平均质量,同时悄悄降低冲突重度。 相反,每维培训一个适配器可避免干扰,但丧失数据共享。 因此,我们把类别组织视为头等的训练后问题。

blocks.en: The key mechanism is specific to diffusion and flow SFT. Sample-level rewards do not directly optimize a scalar preference at inference time; instead, they reweight the regression of the denoising or velocity field. Each evaluation dimension can therefore be viewed as inducing a reward-reweighted conditional velocity field. When multiple dimensions favor incompatible generation behaviors, their preferred velocity directions may conflict in overlapping noisy latent regions. Since the MSE objective learns a conditional mean target, joint training with a shared LoRA can average these directions, producing gradient interference and capability averaging. To address this, we organize data categories by their measured optimization compatibility before training grouped adapters.
blocks.zh: 关键机制是SFT的传播和流动。 样本级的奖励在推论时间并不直接优化一个刻度偏好;相反,它们重新权衡去诺或速度场的回归. 因此,每个评价层面都可以被视为诱导一个奖励再加权的有条件速度领域。 当多个维度偏爱不相容的生成行为时,它们偏爱的速度方向可能会在重叠的吵闹潜伏区域发生冲突. 由于MSE目标学习到一个有条件的平均值目标,与共享的LORA联合培训可以平均这些方向,产生梯度干扰和能力平均. 为了解决这一问题,我们在培训分组适配器之前,按其测量的优化兼容性组织数据类别。

blocks.en: Therefore, we propose G 3 -LoRA: G radient- G uided G rouped LoRA. The method first computes a reward-weighted gradient for each data category using the same flow-matching loss used in training ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) . It then computes a global mixed gradient and removes the component of each category gradient explained by this shared direction. The residual gradients define a compatibility matrix: positive cosine similarity suggests that two categories induce similar category-specific update directions, while negative similarity suggests potential interference. We cluster this matrix into groups, train one LoRA expert per group, and merge the experts into a final adapter. Because merging can dilute group-specific updates, we then distill the experts into the merged adapter on its own sampling trajectories (on-policy distillation, OPD) ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提出G 3 - LORA: G 光度 - G uided G rouped LORA. 该方法首先使用培训中使用的相同流量匹配损失计算每个数据类别的奖励加权梯度(Lipman等人,2023年)。 然后它计算一个全局的混合梯度,并删除由这个共享方向解释的每个类别梯度的组成部分. 残基梯度定义了兼容性矩阵:正余弦相似性表示两类诱导相似的类别特定更新方向,而负相似性表示潜在的干扰. 我们把这个矩阵分组,每组培训一名LORA专家,并将专家合并为最后的适配器. 由于合并可以稀释特定群体的更新,我们然后根据自己的采样轨迹(政策蒸馏,OPD)将专家提炼到合并后的适配器中(Agarwal等人,2024年;Fang等人,2026年).

blocks.en: The concrete instantiation uses Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers ( WanTeam et al., 2025 ; Wan-AI, 2025 ; Hugging Face, 2024 ) , 17 non-diversity VBench2.0 dimensions, and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-based QA rewards ( Bai et al., 2025b ) ; we repeat the procedure on CogVideoX-2B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , which differs in architecture and training objective. The broader point is not specific to this benchmark. VBench2.0 provides a convenient taxonomy and evaluator, but the proposed procedure applies whenever a post-training dataset can be partitioned into reward-bearing categories whose interactions are uncertain.
blocks.zh: 混凝土即时化使用Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffuses(WanTeam等人,2025年;Wan-AI,2025年;Hugging Face,2024年),17个非生物多样性V Bench2.0维度,以及Qune3-VL-8B-基于QA的奖励(Bai等人,2025b年);我们重复了CogVideoX-2B(杨等人,2025年)的程序,该程序在建筑和培训目标上有所不同. 更广泛的要点并非具体针对这一基准。 V Bench2.0提供了一种方便的分类学和评审方法,但当培训后数据集可分为相互影响不确定的奖励类时,则适用拟议程序。

blocks.en: • We formulate heterogeneous video post-training as a data organization problem: categories should be grouped according to optimization compatibility, not only semantic labels. • We connect reward-weighted flow SFT to reward-reweighted velocity-field regression, providing a local mechanism for capability averaging under shared LoRA training. • We introduce a residual gradient compatibility measure that subtracts the global mixed update direction before comparing category-specific gradients, and show that the conflict it reveals is reproducible across probe sets and backbones and predicts held-out transfer. • We instantiate the method on two video backbones with matched grouping controls, an independent evaluator, and paired bootstrap intervals, and we locate where merging loses specialist capability and how much on-policy distillation recovers.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们制定各种视频培训后作为一个数据组织问题:应当根据优化兼容性,而不仅仅是语义标签来分类。 我们把奖励加权流量SFT与奖励加权速度-外地回归联系起来,为共享LORA培训下的平均能力提供了一个地方机制。 我们采用了一个剩余梯度兼容性措施,在比较特定类别梯度之前减去全球混合更新方向,并表明它所揭示的冲突可在探测器和主干线之间复制,并预测被搁置的转移。 我们在两个视频主干线上对这个方法进行即时分析,并配对分组控制、独立评估员和配对的靴子间隔,我们确定合并在何处失去专家能力以及政策蒸馏恢复了多少。

blocks.en: For each group G m G_{m} , we train an independent LoRA expert using only samples from categories in G m G_{m} and the reward-weighted objective in Eq. 2 . Group-specific training prevents strongly conflicting categories from sharing all update steps, while still allowing compatible categories to share data. The final adapter is obtained by merging group experts into a single deployable LoRA module with a dense delta-SVD procedure: group LoRA updates are expanded to dense weight deltas, averaged with group-size weights, and recompressed into one LoRA adapter. Appendix F gives the dense merge and recomposition equations. This can be viewed as a weight-space approximation to an ensemble or mixture of skill-specific experts: training creates several local specialists, while merging folds them into one adapter for inference.
blocks.zh: 对于每个团体,我们培训一名独立的LORA专家,只使用来自Gm G_{m]类别和Eq.2中奖励加权目标的样本。 针对特定群体的培训防止了高度冲突类别的共享所有更新步骤,同时仍然允许兼容类别的共享数据. 最终适配器是通过将组专家合并成一个具有稠密的三角洲-SVD程序的单一可部署的LORA模块来获得的:组LORA更新被扩展为稠密的重量三角洲,以组大小的重量平均,再压缩成一个LORA适配器. 附 录 F给出了密集的合并和重新组合等式. 这可以看作是一个重力空间近似于技能专家的组合或组合:培训创造了几个当地专家,而将其合并为一个适配器,以便推论。

blocks.en: The success of grouped training depends on whether the learned LoRA updates remain compatible after merging. If two group deltas satisfy Δ ​ W i ≈ − Δ ​ W j \Delta W_{i}\approx-\Delta W_{j} , uniform averaging can cancel both capabilities. Even when parameter-space cosine is small, the updates may still conflict on real activations. We therefore treat merge retention as a diagnostic: a merged adapter should preserve a substantial fraction of each group expert’s gain on the dimensions inside that group.

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验装置

blocks.en: The base model is Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers. Training videos are generated by the same base model from dimension-specific prompts. Each of 17 non-diversity VBench2.0 dimensions contributes approximately 560 videos. Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct provides reward weights through the dimension-specific QA pipeline; Appendix B describes this reward construction. As a second backbone and objective, we rerun the full procedure on CogVideoX-2B with its native diffusion-denoising loss and rank-128 experts merged exactly into a rank-640 adapter (Appendix I ).
blocks.zh: 基型为Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-diff用户. 培训录像是由同一基模型从尺寸特定提示生成的。 17个非多样性V Bench2.0维度的每个维度都提供了约560个视频. Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct通过尺寸特定的QA管道提供奖励权重;附录B描述了这种奖励建造. 作为第二个骨干和目标,我们重新运行了CogVideoX-2B上的全程程序,其原生的传播-排除损失和128级专家完全合并为640级适配器(附录一).

blocks.en: We evaluate on VBench2.0 dimensions excluding diversity. All main comparisons use a matched evaluation protocol with aligned prompts, seeds, generation parameters, and evaluator settings; Appendix A gives the concrete generation and evaluation details. Uncertainty is estimated by a paired bootstrap over prompts (Appendix J ). As an evaluator independent of the Qwen reward model, we also score the same videos with VideoScore-v1.1 ( He et al., 2024 ) . The retention study in Appendix G is a separate matched diagnostic evaluation and is reported only for analyzing merge behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了不包括多样性的V Bench2.0层面。 所有主要的比较都使用匹配的评价协议,并附有一致的提示、种子、生成参数和评价者设置;附录A提供了具体生成和评价细节。 不确定性是通过一个对齐的靴子圈在拖绳上估计的(附录J)。 作为独立于Quen奖赏模式的评审者,我们也与VideoScore-v1.1(He等人,2024年)获得同样的视频. 附录G中的保留研究是单独对应的诊断评价,只报告用于分析合并行为.

blocks.en: The main comparison includes Base Wan2.1 without post-training; Joint LoRA trained on all 17 reward-weighted dimensions; four M = 5 M=5 partition controls, namely two random partitions, the official VBench2.0 semantic categories, and clustering of raw (unprojected) gradients; the merged Grouped LoRA produced by the dense delta-SVD-style merge; and Grouped LoRA + OPD. The partition controls use the same grouped-LoRA training and merge pipeline as G 3 -LoRA, but their dimension partitions are not selected by residual-gradient compatibility; Appendix C lists all partitions. A separate retention evaluation compares the base model, the merged grouped adapter, and each group-only LoRA evaluated only on the VBench2.0 dimensions assigned to that group.
blocks.zh: 主要比较包括Base Wan2.1不经过培训;联合LORA对所有17个奖励加权维度进行培训;四个M = 5 M = 5分区控制,即两个随机分区,正式的V Bench2.0语义类别,以及原始(未预测)梯度的分组;密集的三角洲-SVD型合并产生的合并组LORA;以及分组LORA+OPD. 分区控制使用与G 3-LORA相同的分组-LORA训练和合并管道,但其尺寸分区不是通过剩余梯度兼容性选择的;附录C列出所有分区. 单独对基准模型、合并组适配器进行保留评价,每个组只评价分配给该组的V Bench2.0维度。

Each entry is the mean cosine similarity between two category gradients after projecting out the global mixed-gradient direction. Dimensions are ordered by the final M = 5 M=5 grouping, so block structure indicates compatible categories and blue off-block regions indicate potential interference.
blocks.zh: 图 2:横跨V Bench2.0维的残余梯度兼容性. 每个条目都是两个类别梯度在投射出全局混合梯度方向后的平均余弦相似度. 尺寸由最终的M = 5 M = 5分组来排序,因此块结构表示兼容的类别,蓝色的离块区域表示潜在的干扰.

blocks.en: Figure 2 visualizes the matrix used for grouping. The strongest positive pairs are not arbitrary semantic neighbors: material and thermotics have mean similarity 0.841, dynamic attribute and thermotics have 0.824, and human anatomy and human identity consistency have 0.709. Conversely, the stable negative pairs reveal conflicts that a naive semantic grouping could miss, such as human clothes consistency versus thermotics (-0.818), dynamic attribute versus human clothes consistency (-0.798), and motion order versus multi-view consistency (-0.630). These values are averaged over five probe stages, making the matrix a staged compatibility estimate rather than a single-batch diagnostic.
blocks.zh: 图2可视化用于分组的矩阵. 最强的正对不是任意的语义邻:物质和热力学意味着相似性0.841,动态属性和热力学有0.824,人类解剖学和人类身份一致性有0.709. 反之,稳定的负对揭示出天真语义组合可能错过的冲突,如人的衣服一致性与热量(-0.818),动态属性与人的衣服一致性(-0.798),运动顺序与多视图一致性(-0.630). 这些数值平均在五个探测阶段进行,使矩阵成为分阶段的兼容性估计,而不是单批诊断.

blocks.en: We choose M = 5 M=5 because it gives a cleaner residual-gradient partition than M = 4 M=4 . Under average-linkage clustering on D = 1 − S ¯ D=1-\bar{S} , the M = 5 M=5 split increases within-group mean similarity from 0.345 to 0.473, improves the within-minus-between separation from 0.559 to 0.633, and removes all negative within-group pairs. In contrast, the M = 4 M=4 split leaves three negative within-group pairs, including one strongly negative pair. The grouping is therefore selected to reduce within-adapter gradient conflict rather than to match a hand-written semantic taxonomy.
blocks.zh: 我们选择M = 5 M = 5,因为它给出了一个比M = 4 M = 4 更清洁的残留梯度分区. 在D=1-S=1-\bar{S}上的平均连线组合下,M=5 M=5 组内拆分平均相似度从0.345增加到0.473,使离间内减数从0.559提高到0.633,并消除组内所有负对. 相比之下,M = 4 M = 4 拆分则留下3对组内负对,包括1对强烈负对. 因此,选择分组是为了减少适应性内梯度冲突,而不是匹配手写语义分类法.

blocks.en: This grouping has two uses in the paper. First, it is a diagnostic result: it shows that reward-weighted category gradients contain structure that is not visible from metric names alone. Second, it defines the grouped-LoRA training plan: each group trains one LoRA expert, and the experts are merged before VBench2.0 evaluation. The downstream results below show that the grouping improves the average score and reduces the worst dimension-level drop, but also exposes a dimension-level tradeoff: camera motion does not inherit the improvement obtained by joint LoRA. Appendix E provides the corresponding dendrogram and stage-wise heatmaps.
blocks.zh: 这种分组在纸上有两个用途. 首先,这是一个诊断结果:它表明,奖励加权的类别梯度包含仅从计量名称中看不出的结构。 第二,它界定了分组-LORA培训计划:每组培训一名LORA专家,专家在V Bench2.0评价前合并. 下面的下游结果显示,分组提高了平均分数,减少了最差的维度水平下降,但也暴露了维度水平的权衡:相机运动不会继承联合LORA获得的改进. 附 录 E提供相应的Dendrogram和相位热图.

blocks.en: This conflict is hidden by the shared direction and is not specific to one backbone. With raw gradients, all 136 category pairs on Wan2.1 have positive cosine similarity; after removal, 75 pairs (55%) are negative, and on CogVideoX-2B 81–87 pairs are negative across three non-overlapping probe cohorts. Resampled probe sets reproduce the Wan2.1 matrix (Pearson 0.847), and residual similarity predicts how a step along one category’s gradient changes another category’s held-out loss (Spearman ρ = 0.256 \rho=0.256 , permutation p = 0.003 p=0.003 ).
blocks.zh: 这一冲突被共同的方向所掩盖,并非一个骨干所特有的. 在原始梯度下,Wan2.1上所有136个类别的对子都具有正余弦相似性;除去后,75对(55%)为负数,在CogVideoX-2B上,81–87对在3个非重叠探测组中为负数. 重复的探测器复制了Wan2.1矩阵(Pearson 0.847),残余的相似性预测了沿着一个类别梯度的一步如何改变另一个类别的搁置损失(Spearman $ = 0.256\rho = 0.256, permutation p = 0.003 p = 0.003)。

blocks.en: 3.3 VBench2.0 results
blocks.zh: 3.3 V Bench2.0结果

blocks.en: Table 1: VBench2.0 comparison on Wan2.1. Grouped LoRA (Ours) obtains the best mean among merged adapters and a smaller worst drop than joint LoRA or the random partitions; OPD raises the mean further. Ties count as neither improved nor degraded; “–”: not computed.
blocks.zh: 表1:V Bench2.0与Wan2.1的比较. Grouped LoRA (Ours)在合并适配器中获得了最佳的平均值,比联合LORA或随机分区的下降更小;OPD进一步提高了平均值. “-”:没有计算。

blocks.en: Table 1 gives the downstream picture. Joint LoRA is slightly below the base model in mean score (-0.07), despite producing gains on camera motion (+8.00), mechanics (+5.18), multi-view consistency (+4.64), and dynamic spatial relationship (+4.00). This pattern is consistent with a single mixed adapter under heterogeneous reward weighting: some dimensions benefit, but the adapter also pays for the mixture with regressions in human interaction (-8.00), material (-7.63), and dynamic attribute (-6.00).
blocks.zh: 表1列出了下游情况。 联合LORA在平均分数(-0.07)中略低于基准模型,尽管在相机运动(+8.00),力学(+5.18),多视图一致性(+4.64)和动态空间关系(+4.00)上都产生了收益. 这种模式与不同奖励权重下的单一混合适配器一致:一些维度有利,但适配器也为人类相互作用的回归(-8.00)、物质(-7.63)和动态属性(-6.00)的混合支付费用。

blocks.en: The two random partitions are also weak: Random partition A reaches 46.38 mean score, while Random partition B reaches 45.82. Both are below the base model, joint LoRA, and Grouped LoRA. Random partition A improves 6 out of 17 dimensions with a worst dimension-level drop of -8.21, and Random partition B improves 8 dimensions but has a larger worst drop of -16.00. The semantic and raw-gradient partitions are only marginally above the base model (47.20 and 47.35); the semantic partition places 13 negatively related pairs in the same group, whereas the residual partition places none. These comparisons indicate that the benefit of the grouped adapter is not explained by simply splitting the 17 dimensions into several smaller LoRA experts; the partition itself matters.
blocks.zh: 两个随机分区也比较弱: 随机分区 A达到46.38平均分,而随机分区B达到45.82. 两者都低于基模,联合LORA,和组合LORA. 随机分区 17个维度中改进了6个,最差的维度水平下降-8.21,随机分区B改进了8个维度,但最差的下降-16.00。 语义分区和原始梯度分区仅略高于基型(47.20和47.35);语义分区在同一组中放置了13对负相关联的对,而剩余分区则没有. 这些比较表明,分组适配器的好处不是简单地将17个维度分成几个较小的LORA专家来解释;分割本身很重要。

blocks.en: Grouped LoRA increases the mean to 48.18, a +1.11 gain over the base model and a +1.19 gain over joint LoRA. The largest gains over the base model occur on multi-view consistency (+8.99), motion order understanding (+8.00), dynamic spatial relationship (+4.00), thermotics (+3.29), and complex landscape (+2.40). These improvements support the main hypothesis that grouping can reduce some forms of capability averaging: the grouped adapter improves the average tradeoff and substantially reduces the worst dimension-level drop compared with joint LoRA. The gain over the base model is positive in 96.6% of paired bootstrap resamples (95% CI [ − 0.08 , + 2.26 ] [-0.08,+2.26] ), so it is a consistent trend rather than a significant difference at the 5% level.
blocks.zh: Grouped LoRA将平均值提高到48.18,比基数增1.11,比联合LORA增1.19. 比基模型最大的收益发生在多视一致性(+8.99),运动顺序理解(+8.00),动态空间关系(+4.00),热学(+3.29)和复杂地貌(+2.40)上. 这些改进支持了以下主要假设:分组可以降低某些形式的平均能力:分组适配器能改善平均权衡,与联合LORA相比,大幅减少最差的维度水平下降. 在96.6%的配对靴子复标(95% CI [− 0.08,+ 2.26] [− 0.08,+ 2.26])中,比基型的增益是正的,因此在5%的水平上,这是一个一贯的趋势,而不是一个显著的差异.

blocks.en: At the same time, the result is not a clean dominance claim. The grouped adapter still degrades material (-4.52), human interaction (-4.00), and several identity or clothing dimensions relative to the base model. It also gives up the joint LoRA’s camera-motion gain: camera motion remains at the base score of 12.00, while joint LoRA reaches 20.00. This is the clearest diagnostic contrast in Appendix Table 8 . VBench2.0 camera motion is a hard label match over CoTracker-estimated motion classes, so improving the mean score and multi-view consistency does not guarantee better camera-trajectory control.
blocks.zh: 同时,结果也不是干净的支配地位主张。 组装适配器仍可降解材料(-4.52),人类相互作用(-4.00),以及与基模型相关的几个身份或服装维度. 它还放弃了联合LORA的相机动作增益:相机运动保持12.00的基准分,而联合LORA达到20.00. 这是附录表8中最明显的诊断对比。 V Bench2.0相机运动是在CoTracker估计的运动类之上的硬标签匹配,因此提高平均分数和多视图一致性并不能保证更好的相机-弹射控制.

blocks.en: Figure 4 illustrates how these dimension-level differences can appear in generated videos. We choose one Composition prompt that requires a dog, a cat, and a basket to remain correctly bound over time, and one Thermotics prompt that requires a visible physical state change under heating. These examples target two different failure modes: relational binding among multiple entities and temporal transformation of material state.
blocks.zh: 图4说明了这些维度层面的差异如何出现在生成的视频中. 我们选择一个需要狗、猫和篮子 随时间而正确捆绑的构成提示, 和一个需要在加热下 明显物理状态变化的热量提示。 这些例子针对两种不同的失败模式:多个实体之间的关系约束和物质状态的时间转变。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative comparison on representative VBench2.0 dimensions. We compare Base Wan2.1 and Grouped LoRA (Ours) on Composition and Thermotics prompts; each row shows five temporal frames from one generated video. In the Composition case, Grouped LoRA more consistently preserves the relation among the dog, cat, and basket. In the Thermotics case, it shows clearer signs of cheese softening or melting. These examples are qualitative case studies and complement, rather than replace, the automatic VBench2.0 scores.
blocks.zh: 图4:代表V Bench2.0维度的质量比较。 我们比较了Base Wan2.1和Grouped LoRA(我们的)关于组成和热导的提示;每行显示一个生成的视频的五个时间帧。 在组成案中,分组LORA更一贯地维护狗、猫和篮子之间的关系。 在热病案例中,它显示出奶酪软化或融化的更明显的迹象. 这些例子都是定性案例研究,是对自动V Bench2.0分数的补充而不是替换.

blocks.en: In the Composition example, the base model produces the requested objects but the basket relation is mostly static. Grouped LoRA (Ours) keeps the dog, cat, and basket relation more coherent across the shown frames. In the Thermotics example, the base output remains close to a static cheese block, whereas Grouped LoRA (Ours) shows clearer gradual deformation, matching the intended heat-driven transformation. The cases therefore provide visual evidence for the same pattern seen in the automatic metrics: grouping is most helpful when the target dimension requires preserving a specific relation or transformation rather than merely increasing generic visual quality. They are single cases, however: over all Composition prompts, the score is essentially unchanged (47.80 versus 48.10).
blocks.zh: 在"组成"的例子中,基模型生成请求对象,但篮子关系大多是静态的. Grouped LoRA (Ours) 让狗,猫,和篮子的关系在显示的框架上更加一致. 在热力学的例子中,基输出仍然接近一个静态的奶酪块,而Grouped LoRA (Ours)则显示出更清晰的逐渐变形,与预期的热驱动变换相匹配. 因此,这些案例为自动衡量标准中看到的同样模式提供了视觉证据:在目标维度要求保持特定关系或转变,而不仅仅是提高通用视觉质量时,分组最有帮助。 然而,它们是单一案例:在所有组成因素中,得分基本保持不变(47.80比48.10)。

blocks.en: 3.4 Second backbone and independent evaluator
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 第二个骨干和独立评价员

blocks.en: Table 2: Second backbone and independent evaluator. Left: CogVideoX-2B, VBench2.0 macro score over 17 dimensions ( × 100 \times 100 ). Right: VideoScore-v1.1 five-aspect mean on the same Wan2.1 videos used in Table 1 . Brackets: paired 95% bootstrap CI.
blocks.zh: 表2:第二个骨干和独立评价员。 左侧:CogVideoX-2B,V Bench2.0宏得分超过17维(×100\times 100). 右:在表1使用的Wan2.1视频上, 裂缝: 95%的靴子CI。

blocks.en: On CogVideoX-2B, which changes both the architecture and the training objective, joint training degrades the base model from 39.87 to 27.95, whereas the grouped adapter reaches 40.99 (Table 2 ). Most of this margin reflects avoided negative transfer rather than a large gain over the base model (+1.12). The joint degradation is already present at 25% of training (36.78), so checkpoint selection does not rescue it, and it is dimension-selective: human anatomy, human identity, and thermotics improve while human interaction, motion order, and motion rationality collapse (Appendix I ), consistent with capability averaging rather than a globally failed run.
blocks.zh: 在改变结构和培训目标的CogVideoX-2B上,联合培训将基本模式从39.87降至27.95,而分组适配器则达到40.99(表2)。 这一差值的大部分反映的是避免了负转帐,而不是比基准模式(+1.12)大增。 联合退化已经出现在25%的训练中(36.78),因此检查站的选择并不能挽救它,它也是维度选择性的:人体解剖学、人类特征和热力学在人类互动、运动秩序和运动理性崩溃时有所改进(附录一),这与平均能力一致,而不是全球失败运行。

blocks.en: Because the training rewards come from Qwen3-VL, we rescored the Wan2.1 videos with VideoScore-v1.1, a learned metric trained on human ratings of generated videos and not built on Qwen. Grouped LoRA improves all five VideoScore aspects over the base model (Table 2 ; Appendix J ).
blocks.zh: 由于训练奖励来自Quen3-VL,我们用VideoScore-v1.1重新评分了Wan2.1视频,这是一个经过人类对生成的视频的收视率培训的学习指标,而不是基于Quen. 分组的LORA比基准模型改进了所有五个视频分数方面(表2;附录J)。

blocks.en: 3.5 Dimension-level diagnostics
blocks.zh: 3.5 尺寸级诊断

blocks.en: To assess whether merging contributes to the remaining dimension-level tradeoffs, we compare each group expert with the merged adapter on its assigned dimensions.
blocks.zh: 为了评估合并是否有助于剩余维度层面的权衡,我们将每组专家与合并适配器就其指定维度进行比较。

blocks.en: In the matched retention evaluation (Appendix G ; group-only row of Figure 3 ), group-only LoRAs reach 48.06 on their assigned dimensions, compared with 48.18 for the merged grouped adapter and 47.07 for the base model. The small average merge gap suggests no global capability collapse, while the larger gaps on multi-view consistency and mechanics indicate that weight-space merging is a plausible source of remaining group-specific tradeoffs. On all six dimensions where the expert beats the base model, the merged adapter is below the expert; on the other eleven, it is above the expert, indicating transfer across groups. Selecting post hoc the better of the two for each dimension gives a diagnostic upper bound of 51.07. Neither rank truncation (error 1.5 × 10 − 6 1.5\times 10^{-6} ) nor sign cancellation between expert deltas (no negative pair in 240 modules) explains this loss (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 在匹配的保留评价中(附录G;图3的仅组列),仅组的Loras在其指定维度上达到48.06,而合并组适配器则达到48.18,基模型则达到47.07. 较小的平均合并差距表明没有全球能力崩溃,而多视角一致性和力学方面的较大差距表明,权重空间的合并是剩余特定群体取舍的合理来源。 在专家击败基模的所有六个维度上,合并的适配器都低于专家;在另外十一个维度上,则高于专家,表示跨组的转录. 为每个维度选择两个值中较好的值后,诊断值上限为51.07. 在专家三角洲(240个模块中没有负对)之间签下取消(Appendix G.)。

blocks.en: Distilling the experts back into the merged adapter (Eq. 6 ) raises the mean from 48.18 to 49.91 (+1.73; paired 95% bootstrap CI [ + 0.42 , + 3.05 ] [+0.42,+3.05] ), closing about 60% of the gap to this upper bound, and improves 12 of 17 dimensions over the base model (Table 1 ; last row of Figure 3 ). The largest gains are on multi-view consistency (+8.07), human interaction (+6.00), and complex plot (+5.07). Human interaction reaches 68.00 although its expert scores 58.00, so OPD does not simply copy the teacher. Recovery is uneven: only 0.71 of the 15.14-point mechanics gap is recovered, composition decreases slightly ( − 0.50 -0.50 ), and camera motion is unchanged. The interval reflects evaluation sampling for one OPD training run; variation across training runs was not measured.
blocks.zh: 将专家重新排入合并的适配器(Eq. 6)将平均值从48.18提高到49.91(+1.73;对齐95%的靴子圈 CI[+0.42,+3.05][+0.42,+3.05]),将大约60%的缺口拉近到这个上方,并在基准模型上改进了12个17维(表1;图3最后一行)。 最大的收益是多视角一致性(+8.07)、人类互动(+6.00)和复杂情节(+5.07)。 人类互动达到68.00,尽管其专家得分为58.00,所以OPD并非简单地抄袭老师. 恢复是不均衡的:在15.14点的力学差距中,只有0.71恢复,成分略有下降(−0.50-0.50),相机运动不变. 间隔反映了对一次业务发展办公室培训活动的评价抽样;没有衡量各项培训活动的差异。

blocks.en: 4 Related work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Text-to-video generation builds on diffusion and flow-based modeling ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ) , with evaluation moving toward multi-axis diagnosis through EvalCrafter, T2V-CompBench, VideoPhy, VBench, and VBench2.0 ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Bansal et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . We use VBench2.0 dimensions as both metrics and data categories. Diffusion alignment and efficient video generation are reviewed by Liu et al. (2026) and Shao et al. (2026) , respectively. Zigzag Diffusion Sampling ( Bai et al., 2025a ) and Weak-to-Strong Diffusion with Reflection ( Bai et al., 2026a ) improve generation through reflective sampling without retraining.
blocks.zh: 文本到视频生成基于传播和流基模型(Ho等人,2020年;Rombach等人,2022年;Peebles & Xie,2000年)。 ,通过EvalCrafter,T2V-Comp Bench,VideoPhy,V Bench,和V Bench2.0(Liu等人,2023年;Sun等人,2024年;Bansal等人,2024年;Huang等人,2024年;Zheng等人,2025年)进行多轴诊断。 我们把V Bench2.0维度作为衡量和数据类别。 传播对齐和高效视频生成分别由刘等人(2026年)和肖等人(2026年)审查. Zigzag 扩散取样(Bai等人,2025年a)和通过反射(Bai等人,2026年a)通过反射取样改进生成。

blocks.en: Our training uses LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct QA rewards ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , but differs from RLHF/DPO-style language alignment ( Bai et al., 2022 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) and diffusion reward optimization methods ( Black et al., 2023 ; Wallace et al., 2024 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2023 ) : the goal is not a new objective, but organizing reward-weighted video data. CRAFT ( Sun et al., 2026 ) studies composite-reward filtering followed by supervised fine-tuning; our focus is instead on which reward-weighted categories should share updates.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练使用LORA(Hu等人,2022年)和Qune3-VL-8B-指示QA奖励(Bai等人,2025年b),但与RLHF/DPO风格的语言配对(Bai等人,2022年;Rafailov等人,2023年)和传播奖励优化方法(Black等人,2023年;Wallace等人,2024年;Prabhudesai等人,2023年b)不同:目标不是一个新目标,而是组织奖励加权的视频数据. CRAFT(Sun等人,2026年)研究综合奖励过滤,然后进行有监督的微调;我们的重点是奖励加权类别应共享最新数据。

blocks.en: The grouping signal is related to gradient conflict and multi-task optimization methods ( Sener & Koltun, 2018 ; Chen et al., 2018 ; Yu et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) , while the merged adapter connects to weight-space merging ( Wortsman et al., 2022 ; Matena & Raffel, 2022 ; Ilharco et al., 2023 ; Yadav et al., 2023 ) . G 3 -LoRA intervenes between these lines: it probes residual category gradients before training specialists, then merges the resulting LoRA experts into one deployable adapter. CASA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) addresses spectral interference when transferring LoRAs to distilled video backbones, whereas we group and merge experts trained on the same backbone.
blocks.zh: 组合信号与梯度冲突和多任务优化方法有关(Sener & Koltun,2018年;Chen等人,2018年;Yu等人,2020年;Wang等人,2021年;Liu等人,2021年),而合并后的适配器则连接到重量空间合并(Wortsman等人,2022年;Matena & Raffel,2022年;Ilharco等人,2023年;Yadav等人,2023年). G 3 - LORA在这些线间进行干预:它在培训专家之前探测残余类别梯度,然后将由此产生的LORA专家合并为一个可部署的适配器. CASA(Wang等人,2026年)在将LORAs转移到蒸馏视频主干线时处理光谱干扰问题,而我们则集中和合并在同一主干线上培训的专家。

blocks.en: Our consolidation follows on-policy distillation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) and the multi-teacher paradigm of Flow-OPD ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . Our distinction lies in constructing teachers by residual-gradient grouping of reward-weighted video categories, rather than by single-reward specialization. MaineCoon ( Bai et al., 2026b ) also consolidates domain-specialized LoRA experts, using preference optimization and reinforced on-policy distillation for streaming audio-visual generation rather than residual-gradient grouping. Our capability-consolidation goal differs from the few-step generation objective of Adaptive Matching Distillation ( Bai et al., 2026c ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的合并遵循政策提炼(Agarwal等人,2024年)和Flow-OPD(Fang等人,2026年)的多教师模式。 我们的区别在于通过奖励加权的视频类的剩余分级分组来构建教师,而不是通过单一奖励的专业来构建教师. MaineCoon(Bai等人,2026年b)还整合了域专门化的LORA专家,利用首选优化和强化政策蒸馏,用于流体视听生成而不是剩余级组. 我们的能力整合目标不同于适应性匹配消化的几步生成目标(Bai等人,2026c)。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: This study covers two open text-to-video backbones of at most 2B parameters and a VBench2.0-derived category taxonomy; on CogVideoX-2B the gain over the base model is small, so the most natural next step is to test whether the same grouping signal appears across larger model families, reward sources, and evaluation suites. Rewards come from Qwen3-VL and VBench2.0 also uses vision-language judgments; VideoScore agreement reduces but does not remove this coupling, and no human study was run. On Wan2.1, the 95% interval of the merged adapter’s gain over the base model includes zero. OPD adds about 205 GPU-hours and was not applied to the control partitions or to CogVideoX. Our gradient compatibility measure is also intentionally lightweight: it is designed as a practical probe for organizing post-training data rather than as a complete account of all denoising dynamics. Future work could combine this probe with richer merge rules, repeated control partitions, and human preference studies to further separate data-organization effects from evaluator- or merge-specific effects.
blocks.zh: 本研究涵盖最多2B参数的两个开放式文本到视频主干线和一个V Bench2.0衍生的类别分类学;在CogVideoX-2B上,基础模型的增益很小,因此最自然的下一步是测试同一分组信号是否出现在更大的模型家族,奖励来源,评价套房中. 来自Qune3-VL和V Bench2.0的奖励也使用视觉语言判断; Video 得分协议减少但并没有消除这种结合,也没有进行人类研究。 在Wan2.1上,合并适配器在基础模型上的95%收益间隔包括0. OPD增加了约205 GPU小时,没有应用于控制分区或CogVideoX. 我们的梯度兼容性测量也是有意的轻量级:它被设计为组织培训后数据的实用探测器,而不是对所有消音动态的完整描述. 未来的工作可以将这一探头与更丰富的合并规则,重复的控制分区,以及人类偏好研究结合起来,进一步将数据组织效应与评价者-或合并的特定效应分开.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented G 3 -LoRA, a gradient-guided procedure for organizing heterogeneous reward-weighted post-training data. The method computes category gradients, removes the shared global direction, clusters residual compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and consolidates them by merging and on-policy distillation. The central view is that reward-weighted video SFT induces multiple conditional velocity fields, and post-training should ask not only which samples are high quality, but also which reward-weighted samples should share update directions. VBench2.0 results support this view in a qualified way: Grouped LoRA improves the mean score over both the base model and joint LoRA, while reducing the worst dimension-level drop; it avoids joint training’s negative transfer on CogVideoX-2B, and distillation recovers part of the merging loss. Overall, the results position gradient compatibility as a practical organizing signal for reward-weighted video post-training.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了G 3-LORA,这是组织各种奖励加权培训后数据的梯度指导程序。 该方法计算类别梯度,去除共享的全球方向,集群剩余兼容性,培训特定组的LORA专家,并通过合并和在政策上提炼来整合. 中心观点是奖励加权视频SFT诱导多个有条件的速度场,训练后不仅应当询问哪些样本质量高,哪些奖励加权样本应当共享更新方向. V Bench2.0结果以限定的方式支持这一观点:分组LORA比基模和联合LORA都提高了平均分数,同时减少了最差的维度水平下降;它避免了联合训练在CogVideoX-2B上的负转移,蒸馏还原了合并损失的一部分. 总体而言,结果将梯度兼容性定位为奖励加权视频培训后的实际组织信号.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: The method is a post-training data organization procedure and does not directly introduce a new video generation backbone. Its positive impact is that it may make post-training more data-efficient and more diagnosable by exposing when training categories interfere. Its negative impact follows the underlying model class: improved video generation can also improve misleading or harmful generated media. Any future release of trained adapters or generated videos should therefore follow the safety and licensing constraints of the base model and benchmark assets, and should document whether generated samples are filtered before release.
blocks.zh: 该方法属于培训后数据组织程序,不直接引入新的视频生成主干线. 其积极影响是,如果培训类别受到干扰,就可能使培训后的数据效率更高,更能诊断。 其负面影响跟随基本模型类:改进视频生成也可以改善误导或有害生成的媒体. 因此,今后发布任何训练有素的适配器或制作的录像,都应遵循基准模型和基准资产的安全和许可限制,并应记录生成的样品是否在发布前经过过滤。

blocks.en: Appendix B Qwen-based reward construction
blocks.zh: 附录B 以文为基础的奖励建设

blocks.en: The reward pipeline converts each generated training video into a scalar sample weight. It uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct in two stages. First, for each prompt and VBench2.0 dimension, Qwen generates a small set of dimension-specific yes/no QA items from a prompt template. Second, Qwen watches the generated video and answers each QA item with either “Yes” or “No”. A sample receives credit for a QA item when the video answer matches the expected answer generated from the text prompt.
blocks.zh: 奖励管道将每个生成的训练录影带转换成标本重量. 它分两个阶段使用Qune3-VL-8B-指令. 首先,对于每个即时和V Bench2.0维度,Quen从一个即时模板中生成一组小的特有维度的是/否QA项目. 第二,Quen观看生成的视频,用“是”或“否”回答每个质量保证项目。 当视频解答与文本提示生成的预期解答匹配时,样本会获得QA项的信用.

blocks.en: For Motion Order Understanding, the QA-generation template instructs Qwen to identify the main subject’s core action events and produce two to four yes/no questions about their temporal order. For example, if the prompt describes a subject clapping, bending down, and then picking up a bag, the generated QA items should ask whether the earlier action happens before the later action, or whether the later action starts after the earlier action finishes. The template explicitly excludes camera movement, shot changes, clothing, background, and other non-action properties so that the reward targets event order rather than general visual quality.

blocks.en: To separate group training quality from merge-induced compression, we run a retention evaluation on the five group-specific LoRA experts. Each group-only LoRA is evaluated only on the VBench2.0 dimensions assigned to that group, and the resulting dimension scores are compared with the base model and the merged rank-40 adapter under a matched quick-evaluation protocol. This is an oracle-style diagnostic rather than a deployable single-model result: it asks whether the merged adapter preserves the capabilities learned by the group experts, rather than only whether the final merged model improves the average score.

blocks.en: Each OPD step processes one training prompt per GPU. (i) The current student samples an 8-step trajectory from fresh Gaussian noise without gradient, and two interior latent states z τ z_{\tau} are stored with their timesteps. (ii) The prompt’s dimension selects its group expert ψ m ⁡ ( p ) \psi_{m(p)} ; the frozen expert and the frozen merged anchor ϕ 0 \phi_{0} predict velocities at the stored states. (iii) The student predicts velocities at the same states, and Eq. 6 is minimized with respect to the student LoRA only. All LoRA states share the same frozen base model and are swapped in place, so no additional backbone copy is required. The loss does not use the training videos, the flow-matching target of Eq. 2 , or the reward weights. Table 5 lists the hyperparameters, and Table 17 reports the change of every dimension relative to the merged adapter.
